Anodized 3D-printed titanium implants with dual micro- and nano-scale topography promote interaction with human osteoblasts and osteocyte-like cells.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Transferable Skim only in_vitro Exp. validation
Karan Gulati, Matthew Prideaux, Masakazu Kogawa, Luis Lima-Marques, Gerald J Atkins et al. Journal of tissue engineering and regenerative medicine 2017-12-01 10.1002/term.2239
单位: School of Chemical Engineering, University of Adelaide, SA, 5005, Australia.
通讯: Dusan Losic @ School of Chemical Engineering, University of Adelaide, SA, 5005, Australia. [推断]
相关性: 该论文涉及3D打印钛合金植入物的表面改性，但未涉及应力遮挡或力学性能匹配，与用户研究方向有部分重叠但非核心。
边界: No mechanical testing (stress shielding, fatigue, stiffness) and no porous structure optimization; focuses on in vitro cell response only.
动机· 通过双尺度表面形貌增强3D打印钛植入物的骨整合能力
方法· 结合3D打印与阳极氧化制备微米球及纳米管双尺度表面
结果· 人成骨细胞粘附和成骨表型基因表达均增强
验证· 体外培养人成骨细胞及基因表达分析
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve osseointegration of 3D-printed titanium implants by creating a dual micro- and nano-scale surface topography.
Method· Combined 3D printing of Ti6Al4V with anodization to produce micron-sized spherical particles and vertically aligned titania nanotubes.
Result· Enhanced osteoblast adhesion and osteogenic gene expression at day 7 and day 21.
Validation· In vitro culture of human osteoblasts and qPCR gene expression analysis.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Transferable Save for project mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Haider Ali, Hassan Ghadbeigi, Kamran Mumtaz Materials Science and Engineering A 2017-12-01 10.1016/j.msea.2017.11.103
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Sheffield, Sheffield, UK
通讯: Kamran Mumtaz @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, University of Sheffield, Sheffield, UK
相关性: 该论文研究了激光扫描策略对Ti6Al4V残余应力和力学性能的影响，可为增材制造生物医用植入物的工艺优化提供参考。
边界: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, or osseointegration; it focuses on scanning strategies and residual stress in solid Ti6Al4V parts without biomedical context.
动机· 探究扫描策略对SLM Ti6Al4V残余应力和力学性能的影响
方法· 采用不同扫描向量长度和旋转角度的策略，结合实验与有限元模拟
结果· 90°交替扫描策略残余应力最低，重扫描降低残余应力但损害延展性
验证· 通过残余应力测量、拉伸测试和ABAQUS模拟验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the effect of scanning strategies on residual stress and mechanical properties of SLM Ti6Al4V parts.
Method· Different scan vector lengths and rotation angles were applied, combined with experimental characterization and finite element simulation using ABAQUS.
Result· The 90° alternating scanning strategy yielded the lowest residual stress, while rescanning with 150% energy density reduced residual stress by 33.6% but led to premature failure.
Validation· Validation through residual stress measurements, tensile testing, and finite element simulation.

单位: Key Laboratory of Surficial Geochemistry of Ministry of Education, School of Earth Sciences and Engineering Nanjing University Nanjing China
通讯: Xiaoqing Shi @ Key Laboratory of Surficial Geochemistry of Ministry of Education, School of Earth Sciences and Engineering Nanjing Univ
相关性: 该论文提出的自适应采样策略可用于构建生物力学有限元代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学应用。
边界: This paper focuses on groundwater modeling and does not address implant mechanics, biomechanics, or FEA surrogate for biomedical design.
动机· 地下水模型计算昂贵，需要高效采样策略构建代理模型。
方法· 提出基于泰勒展开的自适应采样方法，用混合得分函数搜索信息样本。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To reduce the computational cost of global sensitivity analysis and uncertainty quantification in groundwater modeling by constructing accurate surrogate models with minimal training samples.
Method· A Taylor expansion-based adaptive design (TEAD) strategy that uses a hybrid score function to select informative samples and a robust stopping criterion to ensure approximation accuracy.
Result· TEAD outperformed two widely used experimental design methods on seven analytical functions and two groundwater models, improving computational efficiency for GSA and UQ.
Validation· Validated on analytical benchmarks and real-world groundwater models, comparing against existing experimental design methods.

Motivation· To quantify arsenic mobilization and attenuation during injection of treated coal seam gas co-produced water into deep aquifers.

Validation· Validated against field injection trial data and laboratory batch experiments.

Motivation· To investigate whether local delivery of deferoxamine enhances bone formation and osseointegration in a rabbit segmental bone defect model bridged by 3D-printed grafts.

Validation· In vivo rabbit study with micro-CT and histological assessment at 8 weeks.

Motivation· This retrospective study evaluated treatment outcomes of six immediately loaded implants with tilted distal implants in atrophic edentulous maxillae.

Dislocation Rates following Anterior Approach THA: The Role of Functional Pelvic Tilt

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore clinical Exp. validation
Colin McNamara, Eric M. Slotkin, Amar Mutnal, Wael K. Barsoum, Juan C. Suárez et al. The Journal of Hip Surgery 2017-12-01 10.1055/s-0038-1635101
单位: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Cleveland Clinic Florida, Weston, Florida
通讯: Colin McNamara @ Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Cleveland Clinic Florida, Weston, Florida
相关性: 该论文关注全髋关节置换术后脱位率与髋臼杯放置，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动分析。
边界: No biomechanical modeling of femoral stem, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no FEA or contact mechanics.
动机· 评估基于功能性骨盆倾斜的髋臼杯放置对脱位率的影响。
方法· 前瞻性队列研究1597例直接前入路全髋置换，测量杯位置并记录脱位。
结果· 脱位率0.56%，多数脱位发生在安全区内。
验证· 临床随访1年以上，放射学测量杯位置。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate whether acetabular cup placement based on functional pelvic tilt reduces dislocation rates in direct anterior approach THA.
Method· A prospective cohort of 1,597 primary DAA THA patients was followed, with cup position measured radiographically and dislocations recorded.
Result· The dislocation rate was 0.56%, with most dislocations occurring within the conventional safe zone.
Validation· Clinical follow-up for a minimum of 1 year with radiographic measurement of cup orientation.

Research progress in the use of surgical robotic systems in arthroplasty

Exclude Hip Implant & Femoral Stem openalex Peripheral Ignore none Review
Guoliang Wu, Zhibo Zheng, Xisheng Weng Zhonghua guke zazhi 2017-12-01 10.3760/cma.j.issn.0253-2352.2017.23.008
单位: Department of Orthopaedics, Peking Union Medical College Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, Beijing 100730, China
通讯: Guoliang Wu @ Department of Orthopaedics, Peking Union Medical College Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences, Beijing 100730,
相关性: 该论文综述了关节置换手术机器人系统，未涉及股骨柄假体的应力遮挡或微动分析。
边界: This paper is a clinical review of robotic arthroplasty systems, with no biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding or micromotion quantification, and no FEA or implant mechanics.
动机· 综述关节置换手术机器人系统的研究进展
方法· 分类介绍被动、半自主和自主机器人系统及其导航方式
结果· 机器人辅助可提高手术精度，但存在手术时间长、成本高等问题
验证· 文献综述，无实验验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· This review summarizes the development and clinical application of robotic systems in arthroplasty.
Method· It categorizes robotic platforms into passive, semiautonomous, and autonomous systems and describes their navigation approaches.
Result· Robotic assistance improves accuracy in component alignment and bone morphing but increases operative time and cost.
Validation· The paper is a narrative review without experimental validation.
